reviews.name: Abe Van
reviews.quote:
Big thanks to Jake and Daniel from Grade A Plumbing for the great service.
  
  They helped replace our old toilet and also recommended new tap washers, which have made a huge difference. The whole job was done neatly, the bathroom was left clean, and everything was explained in a simple way.
  
  Really happy with the result. If you need a reliable local plumber for toilet installation, tap repairs, leaking taps or general plumbing work, I’d happily recommend Grade A Plumbing.

reviews.name: Ali Brigstocke
reviews.quote: A blocked kitchen sink drain and a worn tap washer both needed attention,so getting them sorted in one visit was ideal. The plumber arrived right at the beginning of the scheduled service window, which we really appreciated. He was courteous, efficient,and completed both repairs without unnecessary delays. The final charge matched the estimate exactly, with no surprise fees or additional costs.The whole experience was professional, straightforward, and reasonably priced. We'd definitely call again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.name: Zane Keane
reviews.quote: We called Grade A Plumbing Melbourne after discovering a leaking pipe beneath our kitchen sink at our home.The plumber quickly identified the cause of the leak, replaced the worn fittings, and checked the rest of the pipework to make sure there weren't any other issues.Everything was completed efficiently, the work area was left clean, and the whole process was explained clearly.It was a smooth experience from start to finish, and we'll definitely use Grade A Plumbing Melbourne again if we ever need a plumber.
